# orchestra_imported_pipeline (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `default_branch` (String) The default branch of the repository.
- `repository` (String) The repository slug or URL.
- `storage_provider` (String) The storage provider inferred from the repository URL.
- `yaml_path` (String) Path to the pipeline YAML file within the repository.

### Optional

- `alias` (String) The alias to identify the pipeline in Orchestra.
- `working_branch` (String) The branch to import from.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the pipeline was created.
- `data` (Attributes) JSON representation of the pipeline YAML. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `id` (String) The pipeline ID.
- `name` (String) The pipeline name.
- `num_tasks` (Number) Number of tasks in the pipeline.
- `paused` (Boolean) Whether the pipeline is paused.
- `updated_at` (String) When the pipeline was last updated.
